def transform(grid):
    # The two marker colors flank a central blank region; take the right-hand marker.
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(row[c] not in (0, 5) for row in grid)]
    color = grid[next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row[cols[-1]] not in (0, 5))][cols[-1]]
    return [[color, color], [color, color]]
